title: Review the new bounded foreground OmniRoute launcher and its STOP recovery
task: Perform a narrow read-only code review of the NEW foreground launcher and tests supplied here. This replaces the old general supervisor design task; do not repeat an architecture proposal. Identify concrete bugs in exact-job selection, preflight-before-claim order, pausing the existing LaunchAgent, restoring STOP after errors, crash/interrupt behavior, dedupe/no-replay and output review. Distinguish verified code observations from unknown runtime behavior. Rank at most five actionable findings with source/function evidence and one deterministic regression per finding. If worker internals or upstream billing policy are not supplied, explicitly mark them unknown rather than guessing. Do not generate executable shell commands, suggest another queue/scheduler, or claim to have run anything. Keep the memo under 700 words to avoid the previous token cutoff.
deliverable: A bounded code-review memo for the new foreground launcher, suitable for human review; no redesign or automatic execution.
acceptance: Reviews the new supplied launcher and its tests rather than repeating the previous supervisor architecture memo
Every finding identifies a concrete failure path and a focused regression test
Flags hard-crash STOP recovery and missing upstream billing evidence if unproven
No claims of actual Mac execution, approvals, paid routing, or external actions
